text:
QUOTE: "**`char*` returns transfer ownership.** The caller frees them with `entropic_free()`." and "**`const char*` returns are borrowed.** They belong to the handle and are valid until the next call on that handle."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states both halves of the rule: a returned `char*` is owned by the caller and freed with `entropic_free`, and a `const char*` is owned by the handle and valid until the next call on it.
